Two wide straps, each with its own metal pin buckle, so you can set the fit across your toes and across your instep separately. The iconic cork-latex footbed that Birkenstock is known for is where the upper fits to and your foot rests on. The same sandal is worn by both men and women, with sizing in length and width. The standard sizes are Regular in Euro sizes while the UK conversion is given here in the listing.

See every Birkenstock Arizona we have in stock

What size Arizona should I get? Should I size up or down?

We've found that regular is the most popular size and many of our customers know what they normally wear in a Birkenstock. If you are new to Birkenstock choose the nearest UK size, going up one size if unsure, or on the border.

Your toes should have a little room and not hang off the front while your heel sits snug in the groove at the back. Give it time to mould, as it takes a few days before the comfort starts setting in.

Our most popular Arizona sizes are EU 39, 38 and 40.

The straps adjust, so you can have it tight or loose. A slim foot or a high instep is sorted at the buckles. They don't change the length, so get the length right first. Start with regular width, as that is the standard, unless you specifically know your foot is narrow.
